title: A similarity matrix that changes while the model does not
promptMarkdown: Take row representations H=[[1,0],[1,1]] and output weights v=(1,1). Compute G=HHᵀ and the cosine-similarity matrix. Now transform H'=HR with R=diag(2,1/2) and v'=R⁻¹v. Compute predictions, new Gram matrix and off-diagonal cosine. Explain why unchanged predictions need not imply unchanged raw representation similarity, and identify transformations that do preserve G.
hintLadder: Compute predictions before and after rescaling.
Normalise each Gram entry by the two row norms for cosine.
Use RRᵀ to see which transforms preserve the Gram matrix.
